name: submit_claim
description: Submit a new insurance claim for processing. Registers the claim, assigns an adjuster, and returns next steps and required documents. Writes to the demo claims table when configured.

claim_type.description: Type of claim (One of: auto, home, health, life, property, liability)

description.description: Detailed description of the incident or loss

incident_date.description: Date of the incident in YYYY-MM-DD format

name: get_claim_status
description: Get the current status, stage progress, timeline, documentation status, and fraud risk score of an insurance claim.

name: assess_damage
description: AI-assisted damage assessment for a claim. Estimates repair cost range, severity rating, and confidence based on submitted evidence, and recommends fast-track, standard review, or detailed investigation.

damage_type.description: Type of damage (One of: vehicle, structural, water, fire, medical, theft)

name: list_claims
description: List claims with an optional status filter and lookback window. Returns claim summaries with amounts, priority, fraud risk, and portfolio totals.

status_filter.description: Filter by status (One of: all, open, pending, closed, flagged; Default: all)

days.description: Number of days to look back (max 90) (Default: 30)
